column1: Peritya has many AoE skills, allowing her to quickly take down multiple targets. This is a good match for Pecheneg-SP's ability to increase damage after hitting many targets.
column2: Peritya punya banyak skill AoE, sehingga bisa cepat menumbangkan banyak target sekaligus. Ini cocok sekali dengan kemampuan Pecheneg-SP yang menaikkan damage setelah mengenai banyak target.

column1: On the whole, Peritya relies on her characteristic of increasing damage based on her leftover mobility, coordinating her fixed key and common key choices to improve her mobility and damage. At the same time, high mobility allows Peritya to fine-tune her skill usage and gives her more freedom in positioning for Assist.
column2: Secara keseluruhan, Peritya mengandalkan ciri khasnya yang menaikkan damage berdasarkan sisa mobility, dengan memadukan pilihan fixed key dan common key untuk menambah mobility dan damage-nya. Sekaligus, mobility yang tinggi membuat Peritya bisa mengatur pemakaian skill lebih presisi dan lebih bebas memilih posisi untuk Assist.

column1: Lenna can apply Conductivity to enemies, which is a perfect match for Löwenjunges' ability to apply additional fixed damage and Paralysis, as well as its ability to ignore defense.
column2: Lenna bisa menempelkan Conductivity ke musuh, dan itu pas sekali dengan kemampuan Löwenjunges yang memberi fixed damage tambahan dan Paralysis, sekaligus kemampuannya mengabaikan defense.

column1: Lenna has above-average mobility, which goes well with Classified Manuscript's ability to increase damage, which goes a long way toward improving Lenna's damage output.
column2: Lenna punya mobility di atas rata-rata, dan itu cocok dengan kemampuan Classified Manuscript yang menaikkan damage, sehingga output damage Lenna terdongkrak jauh.

column1: Lenna can apply Electric debuffs to the enemy, which perfectly suits the UMP9's conditions for increasing its damage and ignoring defense.
column2: Lenna bisa menempelkan debuff Electric ke musuh, dan itu pas sekali dengan syarat UMP9 untuk menaikkan damage dan mengabaikan defense.

column1: Fixed Keys: the core concept of this build is to apply as many control effects as possible. Immediate Response and Potential For More Power have a higher chance of applying Conductivity and Paralysis. Meanwhile, Driving Force helps Lenna recover Confectance Index.\nCommon Keys: Shattering Stone and Silk can help Lenna move to a better position when using her ultimate skill, giving her better coverage for the enemy. Other common keys should be used to increase her AoE damage and improve her control ability.
column2: Fixed Key: inti build ini adalah menempelkan efek kendali sebanyak mungkin. Immediate Response dan Potential For More Power memperbesar peluang menempelkan Conductivity dan Paralysis. Sementara itu, Driving Force membantu Lenna memulihkan Confectance Index.\nCommon Key: Shattering Stone dan Silk membantu Lenna berpindah ke posisi yang lebih bagus saat memakai skill ultimate-nya, sehingga jangkauannya ke musuh lebih luas. Common key lain sebaiknya dipakai untuk menaikkan damage AoE dan memperkuat kemampuan kendalinya.

column1: For boss battles, her fixed key and common key choices should be aimed at increasing her damage output as well as converting enemy buffs into debuffs in order to lower the enemy's mobility and weaken the boss.
column2: Untuk pertarungan boss, pilihan fixed key dan common key-nya sebaiknya diarahkan untuk menaikkan output damage sekaligus mengubah buff musuh jadi debuff, supaya mobility musuh turun dan boss-nya melemah.

column1: Killing enemies and Extra Action can stack damage buffs, which neatly dovetails with Sharkry's Extra Action skills like In The Limelight.
column2: Membunuh musuh dan Extra Action bisa menumpuk buff damage, dan itu klop dengan skill Extra Action milik Sharkry seperti In The Limelight.

column1: Increasing the damage of her next attack after spending 3 Confectance Index is a perfect match for In The Limelight, which expends 3 Confectance Index.
column2: Menaikkan damage serangan berikutnya setelah menghabiskan 3 Confectance Index pas sekali dengan In The Limelight, yang memang memakai 3 Confectance Index.

column1: The fact that Extra Actions increase damage are a good match for Sharkry's Extra Action skills like In The Limelight.
column2: Fakta bahwa Extra Action menaikkan damage cocok dengan skill Extra Action milik Sharkry seperti In The Limelight.

column2: Fixed Key: fixed key Prey Locked menaikkan damage ke boss secara besar-besaran, sementara Leader's Intimidation menambah damage yang diberikan. Appropriate Caution memperbaiki burst damage awalnya.\nCommon Key: secara keseluruhan diarahkan untuk menaikkan damage.

column2: Littara punya banyak skill AoE, sehingga bisa cepat menumbangkan banyak target sekaligus. Ini pas sekali dengan cara kerja Optical Illusion yang memberi damage AoE lebih besar setelah mengenai banyak target.

column1: Littara has many AoE skills, which is a good match for Mjölnir's trait to inflict debuffs to enemies when dealing AoE damage.

column1: Lotta's AoE skills can cover many enemies, which makes good use of Expeditionary Pigeon's trait to do extra damage to targets with full Confectance Index. At the same time, she can inflict Stability Loss II to multiple targets at once, providing a solid base for breaking stability.
column2: Skill AoE Lotta bisa menjangkau banyak musuh, sehingga sifat Expeditionary Pigeon yang memberi damage tambahan ke target dengan Confectance Index penuh termanfaatkan dengan baik. Sekaligus, dia bisa menempelkan Stability Loss II ke banyak target sekaligus, jadi fondasi yang kokoh untuk mematahkan stability.

column1: Lotta's AoE skills all require the expenditure of Confectance Index, which syncs perfectly with the Super 90's trait of increasing damage as Confectance Index is spent.
column2: Semua skill AoE Lotta butuh Confectance Index, dan itu selaras sempurna dengan sifat Super 90 yang menaikkan damage seiring Confectance Index dipakai.

column1: Suomi's core mechanic is to apply shields in order to ensure the entire team's survival. When Unspoken Calling is given attachments with Ultimate Pursuit, it greatly increases the amount of shields applied by Suomi and provides a safer environment for the team.
column2: Mekanik inti Suomi adalah memasang shield demi menjaga seluruh tim tetap hidup. Saat Unspoken Calling dipasangi attachment dengan Ultimate Pursuit, jumlah shield yang dipasang Suomi naik drastis dan tim jadi jauh lebih aman.

column1: Suomi can use this weapon to provide extra shields, as well as enhance her team healing abilities from her passive.
column2: Suomi bisa memakai senjata ini untuk memberi shield tambahan, sekaligus memperkuat kemampuan heal tim dari passive-nya.

column1: Klukai has many skills which can deal AoE Corrosion damage, which allow her to quickly max out her weapon's damage boost buffs. Corrosive Infusion and Toxic Infiltration also benefit from the weapon's damage boost, making them a perfect match for each other.
column2: Klukai punya banyak skill yang bisa memberi damage Corrosion AoE, sehingga dia cepat memaksimalkan buff damage dari senjatanya. Corrosive Infusion dan Toxic Infiltration juga ikut menikmati dongkrakan damage senjata itu, jadi keduanya benar-benar saling melengkapi.

column1: Klukai has many AoE skills, which syncs perfectly with how this weapon does more damage when hitting 2 or more targets with an attack.
column2: Klukai punya banyak skill AoE, dan itu selaras sempurna dengan cara kerja senjata ini yang memberi damage lebih besar saat satu serangan mengenai 2 target atau lebih.

column1: Fixed Key: Through team composition, Klukai can rapidly recover Confectance and reduce skill cooldown times via allies' Support Attacks, accelerating the release of various AoE skills.\nCommon Key: The core idea is to increase AoE capability and Phase damage.
column2: Fixed Key: lewat susunan tim, Klukai bisa cepat memulihkan Confectance dan memangkas waktu cooldown skill melalui Support Attack sekutu, sehingga berbagai skill AoE bisa dilepas lebih cepat.\nCommon Key: gagasan intinya adalah menaikkan kemampuan AoE dan damage Phase.

Although the Ultimate skill's attack range is reduced, careful operation to ensure the Ultimate only hits the boss can significantly boost damage.\nCommon Key: The core idea is to increase Phase damage.
column2: Fixed Key: gagasan intinya adalah memaksimalkan damage dengan menaikkan damage Acidic Deluge dan skill Ultimate. Meski jangkauan serangan Ultimate-nya menyempit, dengan operasi yang cermat agar Ultimate hanya mengenai boss, damage-nya bisa naik jauh.\nCommon Key: gagasan intinya adalah menaikkan damage Phase.

column1: Mechty has the ability to turn teammates' AoE Support Attack's damage type into Corrosion, which matches perfectly with the weapon trait that enhances allied Corrosion damage. At the same time, Mechty can also boost her own Corrosion damage through her basic attacks.
column2: Mechty punya kemampuan mengubah tipe damage Support Attack AoE rekan setim menjadi Corrosion, dan itu pas sekali dengan sifat senjata yang memperkuat damage Corrosion sekutu. Sekaligus, Mechty juga bisa mendongkrak damage Corrosion-nya sendiri lewat basic attack.

column1: Mechty herself has the ability to inflict Corrosion debuffs to enemy targets, which aligns perfectly with the weapon trait of dealing increased damage when attacking targets with Corrosion debuffs.
column2: Mechty sendiri bisa menempelkan debuff Corrosion ke target musuh, dan itu selaras sempurna dengan sifat senjata yang memberi damage lebih besar saat menyerang target ber-debuff Corrosion.

column1: Vector's ability to apply a variety of Burn debuffs to enemy units allows her teammates to benefit from a consistent damage boost. In addition, the fact that most of her skills inflict Burn damage matches perfectly with the weapon trait that enhances Burn damage.

Increase Confectance Index on startup, allowing Vector to receive her damage buff from the get-go. Enhances Vector's support capabilities and her synergy with teammates.\nCommon Keys: Given that Vector's Confectance Index is often at a low level and that both her weapon and her skill can apply a variety of buffs, she can take full advantage of many Common Keys.

column1: Belka can increase her damage output by expanding her mobility. She can also deal additional damage by applying Negative Charge to enemy units. The weapon perfectly matches both these characteristics of Belka by providing more damage-boosting effects.
column2: Belka bisa menaikkan output damage-nya dengan memperluas mobility. Dia juga bisa memberi damage tambahan dengan menempelkan Negative Charge ke unit musuh. Senjata ini pas sekali dengan kedua ciri Belka itu karena memberi lebih banyak efek pendongkrak damage.

column2: Belka gampang menikmati efek pendongkrak damage dari senjatanya karena serangannya menempelkan Negative Charge ke unit musuh.

Increases damage output when targeting enemy units with Negative Charge.\nCommon Keys: Belka deals more damage as she depletes her mobility; the Common Keys provide damage boosts centered around the various aspects of mobility.
column2: Fixed Key: memperkuat daya tahan dan mobility sendiri, yang pada gilirannya menaikkan damage. Menaikkan output damage saat menyasar unit musuh yang terkena Negative Charge.\nCommon Key: Belka memberi damage lebih besar seiring mobility-nya terkuras; Common Key-nya memberi dongkrakan damage yang berpusat pada berbagai aspek mobility.

column1: Faye's damaging skills are all physical attacks, which perfectly coincides with Hestia's physical damage boosts. At the same time, Faye frequently closes the distance with the opposition, which dovetails neatly with its increased damage toward closer targets.

column2: Faye bisa memastikan defense target prioritas tinggi terus-menerus terkena debuff, sehingga kenaikan damage CZ75 konsisten ter-proc.
